a: For this card's 1st effect, you declare a digivolution, then upon revealing this card, you can also choose a Tamer as the card to digivolve, and that Tamer is also treated as a level 3 Digimon. As with the normal digivolution procedure, after revealing this card and declaring a digivolution, you can't choose to not digivolve.
In addition, you can't declare digivolution into this card in the first place unless there is a card on the field that you can digivolve.
Card Q&A.q: Can I choose to not digivolve with this card's 1st effect?

Effect: You may digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your [Takuya Kanbara]s as if that card is a level 3 red Digimon for a digivolution cost of 2.
[When Digivolving] This Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait, it gets +2000 DP.
